worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.summary: Scatters a trail of petals onto a chosen ally and blooms a flower at their feet, restoring about half of their maximum health instantly; on Grassy Terrain the healing rises to about two thirds. A few short-lived flowers are left on the ground. Only others are healed, never the caster.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.use.0: Top an ally up and leave flowers underfoot
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.use.1: Reach two thirds of max health on Grassy Terrain
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.use.2: Mark the rescued spot with a readable flower cluster
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.descript: When the flower opens on the ally it restores %1$s of their maximum health; a stronger bond grows a richer bloom, and Grassy Terrain raises it to about 2/3.
Castable within %1$s blocks; about %2$s petals travel along the line and the bloom opens across a %3$s-block radius.
Plants about %1$s flowers at the ally's feet (they fade on their own); wind-up %2$s and recovery %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.stance.b: Bouquet: more petals, more flowers and a wider bloom with slightly more healing (x1.06), at the cost of a 0.9x range and a longer cooldown - for close care.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.stance.p: Plain: reaches farther with a shorter cooldown and fewer petals and flowers - for rescues across a gap.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.timing: Cast on an ally; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.preferen: On: more petals, more flowers and a wider bloom with x1.06 healing, but a 0.9x range and a longer cooldown. Off: a longer reach and a shorter cooldown with fewer petals and flowers.
The companion blooms on an ally below this health ratio; lower keeps attacking, higher rescues at the first wound.
The companion blooms only on an ally within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher closes a gap first.
